_howto: Each campaign = a deliverable matrix. brief.json lists campaign ids under 'campaigns'; compile expands every deliverable into a render-plan entry. 'route' must exist in models.json routing. 'template' points into studio/prompts/. 'count' = how many variants to generate for selection. Optional: 'requires' lists the project inputs a campaign needs (product, character, scene, campaign; default product+character+scene). A deliverable with 'shot' compiles that shot from campaign.md ('optional': true skips it if the shot isn't there), and 'aspect' may be templated, e.g. {{shot.aspect}}, with 'aspect_default' as the fallback.

fashion-editorial.name: Fashion Editorial
fashion-editorial.positioning: a place, the people, a vibe → one controlling idea, shot as a hero frame plus 2–3 supporting frames; campaign.md is written by the fashion-campaign-director skill (/campaign). Two passes per shot: a Soul 2.0 style frame for look and feel, then a Seedream final that locks faces and SKUs to references.

deliverables.reference_rule: the casting headshot of ONE model in the frame at most (Soul takes a single face); no product photos. Only light, grade, grain and mood carry forward.
deliverables.notes: approve ONE: it becomes @image_1 of the final render
